simple.summary: חֹנֶף (chôneph) means moral filth , i.e. wickedness First listed occurrence: Isa 32 6.

definitions.full: H2612. choneph חֹ֫נֶף noun [masculine] profaneness — ח ׳לִעֲשׂוֺת Isa 32:6 to practise profaneness (+ תּוֺעָה אָוֶַן, נְבָלָה, ).
